description: A single empty rectangular player portrait frame shell for Dungeon Matcher Magical Forest. Native 96x128 pixel art. Front view, symmetric straight rectangular outer rails, sturdy carved warm brown hardwood, each of the four corners has the SAME small diamond shaped carved wooden peg plate centered precisely on the intersecting rails. All 4 corners intact and inside canvas with 3 pixels of transparent padding. Rail thickness about 5 native pixels, corner ornaments about 13 pixels square. Top and bottom rails horizontal, side rails vertical, clean join centers, usable empty rectangular central opening. Small restrained 3-leaf ivy accent near top left and lower right, kept separate from inner opening, no dense leaf clutter. Broad matte 3-tone wood planes, dark deep-brown outline, quiet sparse wood grain, controlled top-left lighting. Exact native pixels, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no tiny speckles. The central opening AND outside are transparent. NO backing, no character, no text, no icon, no jewels, no gold metal, no flowers, no whole scene. Match the supplied Rattlebones reference's chunky contour and shade discipline, not its skeleton anatomy or royal palette. Woodland carved-frame family, simplified mobile game UI asset, no curving log silhouettes.
completion_receipt: get_image returned completed; one frame, transparent, saved asset; charged 6 generations.
